name: Trouble @ Spiral!
source:
Keisuke didn’t have much luck finding a job after his graduation, but he finally found a place to work at his father’s cafe Tenryuu. There aren’t many visitors at all, but it’ll do for now. He also helps out with renting out the nearby apartment Nazuki-sou and many cute girls live there. However, his father went missing and debts start piling up… soon he’ll be evicted! All the tenants help him out to renew the cafe and save their home.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/03/01/march-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
圭介畢業後找工作一直不太順利，最終來到父親經營的天龍咖啡館工作。這裡幾乎沒有客人，不過暫時也算有個落腳處。他還幫忙出租附近的公寓菜月莊，那裡住著許多可愛的女孩。然而，父親突然失蹤，債務也越積越多……他很快就要被趕走了！所有房客都來幫助他整修咖啡館，保住大家的家。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/03/01/march-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
